acceptance.given: An evaluation fixture causes the detached probe process to encounter an infrastructure failure while presenting an otherwise false-negative outcome.

oracle.expected: The evaluation records a terminal failure for the infrastructure-failure false-negative fixture.
forbidden: The fixture is classified as pass or success.
oracle.observable: The targeted evaluator test observes the returned failure classification and non-zero failure result.

acceptance.when: The evaluator processes the infrastructure-failure false-negative fixture.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the targeted evaluator test using the infrastructure-failure false-negative fixture; it must observe a failing evaluation result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Classify an infrastructure failure encountered by detached-probe evaluation as a failed evaluation rather than allowing a false-negative success.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; reverting restores the prior evaluator classification.

slice_hint.state_transition: Evaluation of an infrastructure-failure false-negative case transitions from in progress to failed.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The evaluator emits an explicit failed terminal classification for the infrastructure-failure false-negative case.

acceptance.given: The six matrix cases are configured with Stable and Candidate subjects and their distinct fixtures/state.

oracle.expected: For every matrix case, the Stable subject executes and its pre-execution and post-execution identity/content attestations match.
forbidden: A Stable subject is mutated, replaced, or changed during execution.
Any matrix case omits Stable-subject execution.
oracle.observable: The matrix evaluator's per-case evidence contains Stable-subject execution and matching immutable-subject identity/content records for all six cases.

acceptance.then: Each of the six matrix cases has executed its immutable Stable subject.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the matrix evaluator with a Stable-subject mutation or omitted-Stable execution fixture; the aggregate must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Execute the Stable subject in every matrix case and compare its captured pre-execution and post-execution identity/content so mutation, replacement, or omission fails the matrix aggregate.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; reverting removes the immutable Stable-subject enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: Each selected Stable subject transitions from selected before case execution to executed with unchanged identity/content attested.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: All six case records show Stable-subject execution and equality of pre-execution and post-execution Stable identity/content.

acceptance.given: A matrix evaluation starts with six configured matrix cases, each having the two specified subjects and a distinct input fixture/state.

oracle.expected: Each of the six matrix cases records execution of both specified subjects, yielding twelve attributable subject-execution records.
forbidden: Any matrix case lacks execution of either specified subject.
Any matrix case executes only one subject or no subject.
oracle.observable: The matrix aggregate's per-case execution evidence maps every one of six case identifiers to both required subject execution records.

acceptance.then: All six matrix cases have executed both specified subjects.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the matrix evaluator with one case missing one required subject execution; the matrix aggregate must fail.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Require and record both specified subject executions for every one of the six matrix cases, and fail the aggregate if any case-subject pair is absent.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; reverting removes complete case-by-subject coverage enforcement.

slice_hint.state_transition: The matrix moves from incomplete or unconfirmed six-case/two-subject coverage to complete coverage with every required case-subject execution recorded.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: The aggregate is successful only when evidence contains both subject executions for each of six matrix cases; any missing pair is terminally failed.

acceptance.given: An external process or aggregate is executing under its applicable time or output budget.

oracle.expected: When the time or output budget is exhausted, the execution reaches an explicit unsuccessful terminal outcome.
forbidden: Budget exhaustion is reported as success.
Budget exhaustion remains pending or ambiguously classified.
oracle.observable: The process or aggregate result records budget exhaustion and an explicit unsuccessful terminal status.

acceptance.then: The budget-exhausted external process or aggregate is terminally unsuccessful.
acceptance.when: An applicable time or output budget is exhausted.

failure_intents.selector_intent: Run the external-process evaluation fixture that exceeds its configured time budget; it must return an explicit unsuccessful terminal result.
Run the external-process evaluation fixture that exceeds its configured output budget; it must return an explicit unsuccessful terminal result.

slice_hint.behavior_change: Bound every external process and aggregate by applicable time and output budgets, converting either exhaustion into a deterministic explicit unsuccessful terminal result.

rollback_scope.state_or_schema_compatibility: No persisted state or schema change; reverting restores prior process/aggregate budget terminal handling.

slice_hint.state_transition: A running external process or aggregate whose applicable time or output budget is exhausted transitions to an explicit unsuccessful terminal outcome.
slice_hint.terminal_predicate: No exhausted time or output budget can produce success, pending status, or an ambiguous terminal classification.
